name: claude-mid-delivery-death
description: Misbehavior (test-plan §1): mid-delivery death. The agent starts delivering (a partial assistant turn reaches stdout) and then the process dies abnormally (exit code 37) *before* the terminal `result` event. Models a crash mid-delivery; the FR-AGENT-6 atomicity invariant must still hold on the doc (all-or-nothing, never a partial). `exit` is terminal: the trailing `result` step never runs. Run without --validate.

content.text: Delivering the first half of the change
